name: This is NOT Romantic Advice
source:
A short story which may or may not be about a certain individuals holding onto certain things of potentially high value.

Play it if you want to.
This is not gaming advice.

[From [url=https://topicalvisualnovels.itch.io/this-is-not-romantic-advice]Itch.io[/url]]

這是一個短篇故事，可能與某些人攥著某些或許價值很高的東西有關，也可能無關。

想玩就玩。
這不是遊戲建議。
